title: Ch02 before/after — does the folio-matching pin improve folio-insights?
baseline_run: output/uat_ta_ch02_v5 (pre-pin, 464 units, 3383 tags — the run Damien reviewed, fed a1954d6)
pinned_run: output/uat_ta_ch02_v6 (pinned + gates + decompose + entity-ruler fix, 699 units, 4782 tags)
verdict: MIXED / net-negative on precision — HOLD folio-enrich migration
root_cause: Aggressive whole-string label->IRI resolution (accept top match >=0.6) resolves generic terms to place/agency homonyms; gates key on branch, which is empty on resolved tags, so they cannot see them.
recommendation: Wire gates + calibration + domain prior INTO the label-resolution path and tighten the 0.6 threshold before migrating folio-enrich.
